result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers group all 14 real toggles into sensible sections, use push/email columns and keep marketing separate. A is more buildable: it puts the masters at the top, dims the grid when a master is off, and says which sections start expanded or collapsed. A also calls out frost as time-sensitive with a 'let frost alerts through' quiet-hours exception and care-on/marketing-off defaults, while B never singles out frost or watering as more urgent than other items. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers group the real toggles into sensible sections and use a push/email grid. B is better on the three other rubric items. It puts the master switches and Pause all clearly at the top, dims the grid when a master is off, and gives quiet hours its own section with a 'let frost alerts through' exception. It also says which sections start expanded or collapsed and sets care reminders on and marketing off by default. A says quiet hours sits by Push, but its sketch places it between 'Ideas & summaries' and 'News & offers'. A also never says which items start collapsed, and it doesn't clearly mark frost and watering alerts as time-sensitive.
